description.value: Secret Garden Tea Company is one of Vancouver's oldest tea houses, open since 1995 and voted Best Tea House in Vancouver. Co-owned by sisters-in-law Kathy and Erin Wyder, it specializes in traditional High Tea, an extensive menu of loose-leaf teas, and a lunch menu of sandwiches, salads, and baked goods. Takeout and High Tea To Go options make it a possible midday stop for cyclists passing through the Kerrisdale neighbourhood.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 23m; rack (6 spaces, covered) at 33m; bollard (2 spaces) at 63m. Total: 10 spaces.
